template.p:
Welcome to the Odoo Surveying & Mapping package guide!
This guide will help you manage your end-to-end geospatial business—from initial client inquiries and sales quote creation to equipment planning, field data collection, timesheet tracking, and final invoicing.
Your Odoo Surveying & Mapping package includes fully integrated apps designed to streamline office and field operations:

ul.li: CRM App: Manage client inquiries from web forms or phone calls, track ongoing bidding opportunities, and maintain client history in a visual pipeline.
Sales App: Generate detailed scope estimates (e.g., Topographic Surveys, Boundary Staking, UAV Mapping) with automated task generation upon confirmation.
Planning App: Schedule field crews, drone pilots, and high-value equipment (Total Stations, GNSS RTK Receivers, Scanners) without double-booking.
Field Service & Project App: Dispatch field technicians, execute custom digital worksheets, and capture site sign-offs directly from tablet or mobile.
Timesheet App: Track field hours, travel time, and CAD processing time against specific project tasks for accurate billing.
Invoicing App: Bill milestone deposits, billable time, travel expenses, and tangible goods (e.g., printed blueprints, USB survey data drives).

div.class: o_editor_banner user-select-none lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-warning pb-0 pt-3 o-contenteditable-false

template.p: The CRM App acts as your central inbox for incoming client survey requests.

ul.li: Multi-Channel Lead Capture: Ingest inquiries automatically from your website’s quotation form or manually enter incoming phone calls.
Pipeline Tracking: Move opportunities through stages such as New Inquiry, Site Scope & Feasibility, Proposal Sent, and Won.
Lead Qualification: Capture crucial site metadata early (e.g., parcel numbers, site access conditions, required accuracy standards).
Communication Logs: Send emails, schedule site visits, and log call notes directly within the pipeline card.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-info pb-0 pt-3 o-contenteditable-false

div.p: Leverage incoming leads from your website Configure your website's "Request a Survey Quote" form to automatically feed incoming inquiries into the CRM pipeline and auto-assign them based on region or survey type.

template.p: The Sales App handles complex service quotes that combine service hours, project tasks, and physical items.

ul.li: Automated Task Generation: Setting up service lines (e.g., Topographic Fieldwork, CAD Drafting & Feature Extraction) automatically generates dedicated project tasks upon Sales Order confirmation.
Goods & Physical Deliverables: Add non-service items such as Physical Boundary Stakes, Hardcopy Plats, or 3D Printed Topo Models directly as deliverable products on the same quotation.
Milestone Billing Setup: Define upfront deposits (e.g., 30% upon booking) and remaining balances upon final CAD delivery.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-info pb-0 pt-3 o-contenteditable-false

div.p: Product Service Rules Set your survey product line items to "Create a task in an existing project" or "Create a new project per order" to organize deliverables seamlessly between fieldwork and office drafting.

template.p: The Planning App ensures optimal allocation of certified human resources and field equipment.

ul.li: Crew & Skill Management: Assign shifts based on certifications (e.g., Licensed Professional Land Surveyor, FAA Part 107 Drone Operator, Bathymetric Specialist).
Equipment Tracking: Schedule high-value equipment assets (e.g., Leica Total Stations, Trimble RTK Units, LiDAR Drones) alongside field crews to prevent resource overlap.
Gantt View Scheduling: Reorganize schedules via drag-and-drop based on changing weather conditions or site access delays.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-info pb-0 pt-3 o-contenteditable-false

div.p: Avoid Field Bottlenecks Always assign both the Lead Surveyor and the required Equipment Unit to the same Planning shift to ensure field teams arrive on-site fully equipped.

template.p: The Field Service App connects office operations with field crews via mobile devices.

ul.li: Custom Field Worksheets: Create tailored digital worksheets for each intervention (e.g., Site Safety Assessment, Control Point Log, Instrument Calibration Checklist).
Offline Access: Field technicians can fill out worksheets, attach geo-tagged site photos, and collect client signatures even in remote areas without cellular coverage.
Direct Work Order Updates: Field personnel mark interventions as In Progress or Completed, immediately notifying the office CAD team.

template.p: The Timesheet App records time spent on site, during transit, and in the office during post-processing.

ul.li: Mobile Timer: Field crews start/stop timers directly from their mobile devices while on-site or during travel.
Task Allocation: Differentiate time spent on Field Data Collection, Travel Time, Raw Data Processing, and Final CAD Drafting.
Expense Logging: Capture site-related expenses (e.g., toll fees, monumentation materials, satellite imagery purchase) directly against the project card.

div.class: o_editor_banner lh-1 d-flex align-items-center alert alert-info pb-0 pt-3 o-contenteditable-false

div.p: Seamless Billable Hours Approved timesheet hours automatically flow into the corresponding customer Sales Order for effortless billing.

template.p: The Invoicing App manages financial completion, combining milestone deposits, billable hours, and physical items into clean, professional invoices.

ul.li: Combined Invoicing: Consolidate billable timesheet hours, mileage/expenses, and delivered physical goods (e.g., Printed Maps) onto a single clear statement.
Automated Payment Follow-ups: Set automated email reminders and SMS notifications for unpaid invoices.
Accounting Integration: Automatically reconcile incoming bank payments with open survey project invoices.

template.h2: Do You Want to Go Further?
template.p: Odoo offers even more ways to grow your surveying and mapping business:

ul.li: Use SMS Marketing to follow up with hot leads
Install Maintenance for the follow up of your equipment
Use Sign to send contracts
Try the Inventory app to manage inventory.
